a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly ends with both of us dead. Reserving 8 takes at least 2 operate rounds, so both of us surviving is only about 4% likely. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you take too, the split is random. I'm open to a fairer idea if you have one.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it costs you. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so the generator can rebuild the reserve for your share.
Operating with you now. I'll keep operating until you can take 4, and I won't take anything more.
Still operating. Once the reserve hits 4, take all of it. I'll keep operating or wait while you do.
